task_completion.description: The abdominal CT volume (amos_0001) is loaded into the 3D Slicer workspace.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer interface shows axial, sagittal, and coronal views of an abdominal CT scan.

task_completion.description: A fiducial marker is placed on air (outside the body or in the bowel) with a name containing 'air'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A marker is visible in the 'Markups' list or on the slice views labeled with 'air'; the probe tool or status bar shows a value near -1000 HU at that location.

task_completion.description: A fiducial marker is placed on subcutaneous or visceral fat with a name containing 'fat'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A marker is visible labeled with 'fat'; the probe tool shows a value between -150 and -50 HU at that location.

task_completion.description: A fiducial marker is placed on the liver tissue with a name containing 'liver'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A marker is visible labeled with 'liver'; the probe tool shows a value between 30 and 80 HU at that location.

task_completion.description: A fiducial marker is placed on bone (spine/vertebrae) with a name containing 'bone', 'spine', or 'vertebr'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A marker is visible labeled with 'bone' or 'spine'; the probe tool shows a value above 300 HU at that location.

task_completion.description: The scene is saved to the specified directory ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Scene' dialog box is shown with the file path set to ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/ or a terminal/file explorer confirmation of the saved .mrb/.mrml file.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI to place markers rather than just script execution.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Markups module or the slice views to place points.

integrity.description: The markers are placed on the actual corresponding tissues, not random locations.
integrity.visual_evidence: The visual location of the markers in the CT slices matches the anatomical structures (e.g., 'liver' marker is inside the liver organ).

integrity.description: Markers are not clustered in one spot to ensure calibration across the volume.
integrity.visual_evidence: The markers are visually distributed across different areas of the scan, appearing at least 20mm apart on the slice grid.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected Hounsfield Unit (HU) ranges for the tissues are: Air (-1050 to -950), Fat (-150 to -50), Liver (30 to 80), and Bone (300 to 1500+). There must be exactly 4 markers. Markers must be named according to their tissue type (air, fat, liver, bone/spine). The minimum distance between any two markers must be 20mm.
